violated_contract: A per-call test CPU budget must measure the exercised behavior rather than shared process dependency initialization. A cold real-module import inside the first parameter case charges shared setup to that case and can fail the call budget while every behavioral assertion passes.
canonical_prevention: Load shared real dependencies in an explicit pytest setup fixture before call-phase accounting. Retain the real implementation, external-service mocks, parameter matrix, behavioral assertions and unchanged blocking CPU threshold. Profile the original call to distinguish import initialization from expensive behavior.
